reviewer: entropy_manuscript sub-agent; independent of root implementation
scope: Read source and saved closed metadata only. No production module import or real prepare, metric score, source statistics, bootstrap, GPU, PHY or model call.
passes: Original full-file SHA pins the four extracted definitions; all remaining metric/CDF/preprocessing mathematics is inherited. Exactly two score logical-denominator constants and one wall guard change; independent inverse AST comparison passes.
Prepare builds 100 distinct source groups and exactly 1200 unique method/source/SNR/noise tuples. Allowed Cartesian axes are 2 methods, 4/10 dB and 6201/6202/6203; every source has 12 logical frames.

Gray arrays retain float32 RGB 0.5 pixels and all logical frame entries. Pair deduplication is only within source and exact float-array hash, followed by np.array_equal. No filtering by receiver success or accepted-wrong status is applied.

Prior reuse compares the source archive descriptor and actual pixel bytes. Four-metric identity and supplemental protocol/model metadata/versions/FP32/TF32 identities are checked. Cached raw pair scores, never source averages, are reused.
The actual scoring path verifies unchanged CUDA mapping and frozen four/supplemental identities. Pair ledgers cap new scores only. The reused pairs do not cause image forwards.
Source means require each of the three distinct original noise seeds. Every metric is finite; negative values and zero values are retained without clipping.

The only production random draw site is statistics: np.random.default_rng(2026101902).integers(0,100,size=(10000,100),dtype=int64), after a write-exclusive bootstrap directory and reservation. One saved index array is reused across all metrics and conditions.

Paired intervals resample vectors of source-level NeST minus ARPC differences directly. Marginal intervals are not subtracted. Linear percentile 2.5/97.5 percentiles preserve crossing/touching zero; no winner-dependent repeat or candidate expansion exists.

Score and statistics owner outputs use exclusive directories and the existing shared lock/actual bounded wait helper. Statistics requires score actual exit0 and same-host child PID/start gone. Unknown failure is retained and not retried automatically.

findings.title: Pin the directly executed adaptive shared.py dependency in the B3 metric registration
findings.detail: common.py imports verify/put/cache/Ledger/wait_child and paths from the parent shared.py, but the new registration code list contains only b3_metrics_v1 files and original metrics.py. check() verifies TREG JSON bytes without recursively verifying its code. A post-registration parent shared.py change would therefore not be rejected by current metric source checks.
findings.requested_change: Add pin(ADAPT_E/'shared.py') to code and qualify a changed-shared descriptor rejection; no metric mathematics change is needed.

nonblocking_notes: The zero-new-pair branch is conservative and model-free, but does not emit current four_metric_identity.json or supplemental_identity.json. Existing inputs still pin both prior identities. If the B3 delivery is intended as a future prior_pairs cache, copy or explicitly emit those identities in this branch so it matches the cache schema.

B3 logical score rows preserve receiver_status and accepted_wrong_post_exit, while original native logical frames retain detailed transport rejection metadata. The final report must link those native/transport receipts for correct-delivery/failure/MCS/occupancy tables; the seven-metric summary alone does not supply those fields.
Strict source archive descriptor equality may conservatively reject an alias path rather than reuse equal pixels. That is safe; do not relax it to source_id-only reuse.
pending_qualification: At review start test_metrics.py and README.md were not yet supplied; production prepare must wait for both, source pins, independent closure of B3 native pixels, and synthetic qualification.
No claim is made that the new score, actual statistical bootstrap or final comparison has run. This is source review only.
